name: NextKeyBor
description: Supercharges the GNOME on-screen keyboard: swipe typing, autocorrect and word completion, dictation with language selection (local whisper.cpp), hold-for-numbers and symbols, a number row, emoji search and suggestions, clipboard history, a text-editing panel, a searchable GIF and sticker library with favourites and your own uploads, split and one-handed layouts, and skins. Also fixes the OSK not opening in Chromium/Electron/Qt apps and Shift latching after backspace. Needs the nextkeybord daemon.
